name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
description: A government-backed, one-year renewable accidental death and disability insurance scheme offering coverage to bank account holders at an extremely low premium, providing financial protection in the event of accidental death or disability.
benefits: Accidental death cover of Rs. 2 lakh paid to the nominee, Rs. 2 lakh for total and irrecoverable disability (loss of both eyes, both hands, or both feet), and Rs. 1 lakh for partial disability (loss of one eye, one hand, or one foot), at an annual premium of just Rs. 20, auto-debited from the linked bank account. Coverage period runs 1st June to 31st May, renewable annually.
eligibility: Applicant must be an Indian citizen aged 18 to 70 years
Must hold a savings bank or post office account with auto-debit consent
No medical examination required to join
Premium auto-debited on or before 31st May each year for continuous coverage
how_to_apply: Apply through your bank's net banking or mobile banking app, or visit the bank branch/post office, select PMSBY, provide account and nominee details, and give consent for annual auto-debit of the premium.
